sentences.text: Shri Rajwardhan Gawde, G.A. for State.
Shri Palash Choudhary, counsel for the objector.
Heard on I.A.No. 8145/2025 which is application filed on behalf of applicant Shakir for grant of temporary bail on the ground of marriage of applicant's brother.

2. Applicant is in custody since 29.4.2025 in connection with FIR No.618/2023 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Vijay Nagar, Indore (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468, 471, 34 and 120 of IPC.
3. Counsel for the applicant submits that the marriage of brother of applicant is scheduled on 13.06.2025 and father of the applicant is suffering from paralysis and confined to bed.
In such circumstances, he prays for grant of interim bail.
4. Counsel for the State was granted time to verify the aforesaid factum.
On verification, counsel for the State submits that marriage of brother of the applicant is scheduled to take place on 13.06.2025.

5. After hearing learned counsel for parties and taking into consideration the aforesaid, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled for grant of temporary bail for a period of 10 days i.e. till 16.06.2025.
2 MCRC-24264-2025

Accordingly, it is directed that applicant be released on temporary bail till 16.06.2025 upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court below on the condition that the applicant shall surrender before the concerned trial Court on 17.06.2025.

In case if he fails to surrender on 17.06.2025, the concerned Court shall take necessary steps to arrest the applicant in accordance Shakir vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113099696/
1 with the law.

The bail application shall be considered only after the applicant's surrender before the trial court.
